sloka: न खल्वहं त्वां तुलये नावमन्ये न भीषये ।कर्मभिस्तस्य भीमैस्तु कातर्यं जनितं मम ॥४-११-८०॥।।
transliteration: na khalvahaṁ tvāṁ tulaye nāvamanye na bhīṣaye ।karmabhistasya bhīmaistu kātaryaṁ janitaṁ mama ॥4-11-80॥।।

translations.english: 'The dreadful acts of Vali have made me feel timid. This is not to compare you with him or your strength with his or insult you and scare you.
